senses.gloss: m. (רָבָה, cmp. רַב) (festival of) fructification (Dionysia). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ (expl. תרבות, a reading for תרפות, Mish.
units: ib. II, 3) תּוֹרִיבָם מוליכין וכ׳ their (the gentiles’) festival of fructification, when they carry the larger idol to the smaller (v. Hastings Dict. Bible, s. v. Dionysia); ib. מאן דאמר תרבות תוריבם he that reads tarbuth understands the word to mean their festival &c. [Mus. emends תוריבוס, v. next w.]
